name: @swpanel/runner
description: SWPanel Agent Runner process boundary. Phase 2 implements the SQLite WAL persistence layer, the immutable source-file ledger, the Drawing workflow application service and the WP4 Windows Named Pipe IPC boundary (per-user DACL, protocol handshake, server identity, size-capped framing, validation, idempotency); the Electron bridge and Agent/SolidWorks backends remain later phases.
